```{r setup_and_parse}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyverse)
library(reactable)
library(htmltools)

# 1. Function to parse a single JSON file into a flat dataframe
    parse_blast_file <- function(file_path) {
        js <- fromJSON(file_path, simplifyVector = FALSE)
        if(is.null(js$BlastOutput2)) return(tibble())
        
        map_dfr(js$BlastOutput2, function(b) {
            search <- b$report$results$search
            q_id <- search$query_id
            q_title <- search$query_title
            q_len <- search$query_len
            
            if (length(search$hits) == 0) return(tibble()) 
            
            map_dfr(search$hits, function(hit) {
                desc <- hit$description[[1]]
                map_dfr(hit$hsps, function(hsp) {
                    tibble(
                        query_title = q_title, query_id = q_id, query_len = q_len,
                        hit_num = hit$num, hit_acc = desc$accession,
                        hit_title = desc$title, sciname = desc$sciname,
                        hsp_num = hsp$num, bit_score = hsp$bit_score, score = hsp$score,
                        evalue = hsp$evalue, identity = hsp$identity, align_len = hsp$align_len,
                        q_from = hsp$query_from, q_to = hsp$query_to, h_from = hsp$hit_from, h_to = hsp$hit_to,
                        q_strand = hsp$query_strand, h_strand = hsp$hit_strand, gaps = hsp$gaps,
                        qseq = hsp$qseq, hseq = hsp$hseq, midline = hsp$midline
                    )
                })
            })
        })
    }

# 2. Load and combine data, and calculate custom display columns
blast_hits <- map_dfr(blast_files, function(f) {
    if (file.exists(f)) {
        parse_blast_file(f) %>% mutate(source_file = basename(f))
    } else {
        warning(paste("File not found:", f))
        tibble()
    }
})

if(nrow(blast_hits) == 0) {
  stop("No valid BLAST results found in the provided JSON files.")
}

blast_hits <- blast_hits %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
        q_len_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(query_len)),
        aln_len_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(align_len)),
        ident_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(identity)),
        q_from_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(q_from)),
        q_to_num = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(q_to)),
        cov_pct = ifelse(
            !is.na(q_len_num) & q_len_num > 0 & !is.na(q_from_num) & !is.na(q_to_num),
            (abs(q_to_num - q_from_num) + 1) / q_len_num * 100,
            NA_real_
        ),
        cov_display = ifelse(is.na(cov_pct), "-", sprintf("%.0f%%", cov_pct)),
        ident_pct = ifelse(
            !is.na(aln_len_num) & aln_len_num > 0 & !is.na(ident_num),
            (ident_num / aln_len_num) * 100,
            NA_real_
        ),
        ident_display = ifelse(
            is.na(ident_pct),
            "-",
            sprintf("%.1f%% (%d/%d)", ident_pct, as.integer(ident_num), as.integer(aln_len_num))
        )
    )

id_vec <- if ("ident_pct" %in% names(blast_hits)) blast_hits$ident_pct else rep(NA_real_, nrow(blast_hits))
cv_vec <- if ("cov_pct" %in% names(blast_hits)) blast_hits$cov_pct else rep(NA_real_, nrow(blast_hits))

qc_blast <- evaluate_hit_quality_df(id_vec, cv_vec)
blast_hits <- dplyr::bind_cols(blast_hits, qc_blast)

# 3. Create Main Summary Table
summary_blast_df <- blast_hits %>%
    group_by(query_title) %>%
    arrange(evalue, desc(bit_score)) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(
        query_title, hit_acc, sciname, bit_score, evalue,
        ident_display, cov_display, ident_pct, cov_pct, align_len,
        qc_symbol, qc_sym_class, qc_row_class, qc_reason
    ) %>%
    mutate(qc_status = qc_symbol)

blast_l1_order <- c(
    "query_title", "hit_acc", "sciname", "qc_status",
    "ident_display", "cov_display", "align_len", "evalue", "bit_score",
    "qc_symbol", "qc_sym_class", "qc_row_class", "qc_reason"
)
summary_blast_df_ordered <- summary_blast_df[, blast_l1_order, drop = FALSE]

# Dynamic theme connecting reactable to our custom One Dark Pro CSS variables
dynamic_theme <- reactableTheme(
    color = "var(--tbl-text)",
    backgroundColor = "var(--tbl-bg)",
    borderColor = "var(--tbl-border)",
    stripedColor = "var(--tbl-stripe)",
    highlightColor = "var(--tbl-highlight)",
    cellPadding = "8px 12px"
)
```
